changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetCrossReference') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetCrossReference]( [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [DataSource] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Type] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ExternalID] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [FieldHash] [varchar](50) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetCrossReference] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [DataSource] ASC, [Type] ASC, [ExternalID] ASC, [uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetCrossReference_uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetCrossReference_uid] ON [dbo].[AssetCrossReference] ( [uid] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetCrossReference_uid_DataSource') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetCrossReference_uid_DataSource] ON [dbo].[AssetCrossReference] ( [uid] ASC, [DataSource] ASC ) END
